title: Software Engineer
description: As a Software Engineer focused on modernizing the notary's operations by developing a custom financial and operational management system. Key contributions included gathering requirements from staff, mapping out core legal processes (such as real estate transactions and wills), and designing the system's architecture to include modules for CRM, document automation, and financial control.
description_es: Como Ingeniero de Software enfocado en modernizar las operaciones de la notaría mediante el desarrollo de un sistema integral de gestión financiera y operativa a medida. Mis contribuciones clave incluyeron el levantamiento de requerimientos con el personal, el mapeo de procesos legales centrales (como operaciones inmobiliarias y testamentos) y el diseño de la arquitectura del sistema con módulos de CRM, automatización documental y control financiero.
description_en: As a Software Engineer focused on modernizing the notary's operations by developing a custom financial and operational management system. Key contributions included gathering requirements from staff, mapping out core legal processes (such as real estate transactions and wills), and designing the system's architecture to include modules for CRM, document automation, and financial control.
